name: aletheia-fairness-auditor
description: Automated algorithmic fairness auditing. Detects bias, applies mitigations, and generates reports across 13 statistical and causal algorithms.

interface.shortDescription: Detect and fix bias in datasets and ML models, as a watsonx Orchestrate toolkit.
interface.longDescription: Imports Aletheia's Auditor MCP server (13 bias-detection algorithms: Disparate Impact Repair, Equality of Opportunity, SHAP Proxy Detection, and more) into watsonx Orchestrate as a Remote MCP Toolkit, so an Orchestrate agent can call list_algorithms / load_algorithm_knowledge as native tools.
